text_block_list.text:
These three years with Matikanefukukitaru, 
which felt so long yet went by so fast, 
come to a close today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. That was a truly happy 
time, wasn't it? And now...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The timing for this milestone is great 
too! Being able to celebrate it during 
Hatsumode is just the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right?! We're always on the exact same 
wavelength. We were totally in sync, like 
two performers inside a lion dance 
costume!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, to wrap things up, let's offer a 
prayer together. Um, where's my offering 
money...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, waaaah, I don't have any change~! 
Trainer, please lend me some~~~!

Matikanefukukitaru hasn't changed a bit. 
She's somehow impossible to hate, and so 
charming...

I clasped my hands in prayer, wishing for 
the best outcome.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what did you wish for? Please 
tell me in secret."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, that's not fair~. You could've just 
told me~. Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I won't hide it! Because there's 
only one thing I wish for."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
May endless good fortune come your way, 
Trainer!

Just a single wish. And Matikanefukukitaru 
dedicated it entirely to them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And also, I hope you'll tell me what you 
wished for, Trainer!"
